title: Optimize BaTiO3 geometry
action: Perform hybrid DFT (B3PW) geometry optimization on the cubic primitive cell of BaTiO3 to obtain the equilibrium lattice constant and ground-state wavefunction.
description: Geometry optimization of BaTiO3 using the B3PW hybrid functional, Hay-Wadt small-core ECPs for Ti and Ba, all-electron basis for O (8-411(1d)G), 8x8x8 Monkhorst-Pack k-mesh, and conjugate gradients optimization with numerical derivatives.

title: Optimize SrTiO3 geometry
action: Perform hybrid DFT geometry optimization on the cubic primitive cell of SrTiO3 to obtain the equilibrium lattice constant and ground-state wavefunction.
description: Geometry optimization of SrTiO3, analogous to BaTiO3, using the same functional, ECPs (Hay-Wadt for Ti and Sr), basis sets (O 8-411(1d)G, Sr 311(1d)G), and computational parameters.

title: Construct BST supercell
action: Generate a 2x2x2 supercell of the cubic ABO3 perovskite with layered Ba/Sr ordering to create the equiatomic Ba0.5Sr0.5TiO3 structure.
description: Construct a 40-atom supercell by expanding the primitive cell with a diagonal 2x2x2 repeat and then substituting a set of Ba atoms by Sr to realize the layered arrangement shown in the paper.

title: Optimize BST supercell geometry
action: Perform hybrid DFT geometry optimization on the BST supercell to find the equilibrium lattice constant, keeping all atoms fixed at their fractional positions.
description: Geometry optimization of the layered BST supercell using the same functional, ECPs, basis sets, k-mesh, and optimization method as for the pure compounds.

title: Compute electronic band structures
action: Calculate the band structure for the optimized BaTiO3, SrTiO3, and BST supercell along high-symmetry paths and extract the optical band gap (energy difference at the Gamma point between top of valence band and bottom of conduction band).
description: Using the self-consistent charge densities from the optimizations, compute band structures on a high-symmetry k-point path. Record the optical band gap for each system.

title: Generate DOS and electron density maps
action: Compute total and partial density of states for the BST supercell, and difference electron density maps (total minus ionic superposition) in the (001) and (110) planes to analyze covalency and electron localization.
description: Produce DOS and electron density difference maps (qualitative, not scored) to confirm orbital character and bonding features.

title: Collect results into a scored JSON file
action: Write the optimized lattice constants (in ångströms) and optical band gaps (in eV) for BaTiO3, SrTiO3, and the BST supercell into a single JSON file.
description: Compile the six numeric results from the preceding process steps into a structured JSON object.
output_schema: {"BaTiO3_lattice_constant_A": float, "SrTiO3_lattice_constant_A": float, "BST_supercell_lattice_constant_A": float, "BaTiO3_band_gap_eV": float, "SrTiO3_band_gap_eV": float, "BST_band_gap_eV": float}
